choices: The girl bees: workers and the queen
questions.fact: Only the girls! Worker bees and the queen have stingers, but drone bees can't sting at all.

choices: To protect itself and its hive
questions.fact: To protect! Bees only sting when they feel their hive or themselves are in danger.

questions.q: What is special about a worker honeybee's stinger?
choices: It has tiny barbs like hooks
questions.fact: Tiny barbs! The hooks make it stick in our skin, so a honeybee can usually only sting a person once.

questions.q: If a bee buzzes around you, what is the best thing to do?
choices: Stay calm and slowly walk away
questions.fact: Stay calm! Bees are usually just curious or looking for flowers, and swatting can make them feel threatened.
